newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Borsodchem raises capital in two units.
newsitem.headline: Borsodchem raises capital in two units.

text.p: Hungarian chemicals company Borsodchem Rt said on Thursday it had increased the registered capital of two of its units.

"We have increased to 335 million forints the capital of Ongropack from 75.4 million and to 330 million forints the capital of BC-KC Formalin Kft from 60 million forints," Jozsef Molnar, Borsodchem's finance director, told Reuters.
Packaging unit Ongropack is Borsodchem's wholly-owned subsidiary, while BC-KC Formalin Kft is a joint venture in which Borsodchem has a two-thirds stake and Austria's Krems Chemie owns one-third.

Molnar said that Ongropack's capital increase would enable a capacity increase while the capital increase in BC-KC had been envisaged when the two companies formed it and it would finance the building of a new formaldehyde plant.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Borsodchem closed at 6,110 forints, down 110.
